profile.headline: Front End Developer @ Hydden
profile.summary:
👋🏼 Hi, I'm Markus - a Full Stack Developer based in Maryland, specializing in React and Next.js

📚 I studied computer science and music before teaching myself full-stack web development while working as an IT specialist during the pandemic. That experience gave me a unique mix of technical agility, creative problem-solving, and self-discipline.

💻 I focus on building high-performance, headless Sitecore implementations that integrate seamlessly with modern frontends. My work includes enterprise-scale deployments, custom component systems, and performance optimization using Vercel, SSR, ISR, and CI/CD pipelines.

🚀 I'm driven by creating digital experiences that solve real problems and make a positive impact. My approach combines technical excellence with a deep understanding of user needs.

🏔 Outside of work, you'll find me playing the cello, enjoying music/podcasts, or spending time with friends.

💪🏽 Strengths: Attention to detail, continuous learning, self-motivation, creative problem-solving, and effective communication.
